Ama means mother. A dablam is the charm-box pendant Sherpa women wear close to the heart. 🏔️

Look at the mountain and you can see why: two long ridges reach out like a mother's arms, and the hanging glacier on her face is the pendant. Ama Dablam (6,856 m) rules the skyline of the Khumbu, the Everest region.

🧗 Its Southwest Ridge climbs through three camps and the steep rock of the Yellow Tower
⚖️ Technically it is harder than the standard routes on many 8,000 m peaks
🌄 From the summit: Everest, Lhotse and Makalu

Our 30-day Ama Dablam expedition is private to your team — base camp at 4,570 m, climbing Sherpa support, permits and fixed ropes arranged by our family team in Kathmandu.

Would you climb it — or be happy just to look at it? 👇

Winter in the Himalayas is quiet, clear — and seriously cold. Here's what our family tells every winter trekker. ❄️

🗓️ December to February is possible but hard. The trails are almost empty and the skies are some of the sharpest of the year
🥶 Nights at Everest's Gorak Shep can drop well below −15°C, and Namche sits around freezing even by day
⛔ High passes on routes like Manaslu and the Annapurna Circuit can be snowbound and dangerous in these months
🏠 Some teahouses above Tengboche close for the season, with only a few rooms heated around the stove
✈️ Lukla flights can wait three or four days at either end in winter — build buffer days in
🌤️ Our quiet favourite: late February, with winter solitude and the first hint of spring

We plan every trek privately around the season — sometimes that means saying "go lower this time".

Har Har Mahadev 🙏 Three days, one darshan your family will never forget.

Our Pashupatinath Darshan is made for pilgrims, including elderly parents:
🪔 Day 1 — arrive and join the evening Bagmati Aarti
🔱 Day 2 — unhurried morning darshan and puja, then Guhyeshwari Shaktipeeth and Boudhanath
🚗 No trekking, only short flat walks, private car door to door
🍛 Satvik vegetarian meals on request, Hindi/English pilgrimage guide
🛂 Indian nationals need no visa — passport or voter ID is enough

This year Bala Chaturdashi falls on Monday 7 December, when families keep a lamp vigil at Pashupatinath for loved ones they have lost.

A Himalayan kingdom that stayed closed to outsiders until 1992. 🏜️

Upper Mustang is one of the last places where Tibetan culture survives largely unchanged — eroded cliffs, cave monasteries, apple orchards, and the 15th-century walled city of Lo Manthang, capital of the former Kingdom of Mustang.

Our 16-day Upper Mustang Trek:
✈️ Fly Pokhara › Jomsom, walk in through Kagbeni
🏘️ Village guesthouses at Chele, Ghami and Tsarang
⛰️ Over the Lo La (3,950 m) into Lo Manthang, with a full day to explore
🛂 Restricted Area Permit, ACAP and the mandatory licensed guide all included

Moderate trekking, private to your group, with porters and a pulse oximeter in your guide's kit.
